name: Jimmy Panetta
summary:
James Varni Panetta ( pə-NEH-tə; born October 1, 1969) is an American lawyer, politician, and former Navy intelligence officer from the state of California. 
A member of the Democratic Party, he is the U.S. representative for California's 19th congressional district. The district includes part of San Jose, as well as all of Santa Cruz, Monterey, Carmel-by-the-Sea, and Paso Robles.
